name: foreground-child-named-watchdog
note: The REAL foreground-child watchdog shape (from xmcp@0.6.13, verbatim from npm `foreground-child`), which the minimized foreground-child-watchdog fixture did NOT cover: the handler is a NAMED function (`bark`) whose `process.kill(pid,'SIGKILL')` sits INSIDE the definition, and `process.on('SIGHUP', bark)` registers it AFTERWARD — so process.kill appears BEFORE process.on. The original single-proximity NODE_REAPER regex required process.on -> process.kill in order and missed this, so xmcp still blocked in the 2026-07-19 full re-scan. FIXED: the reaper signature now requires BOTH signals order-independently (NODE_REAPER_SIGNAL_REGEX + NODE_REAPER_KILL_REGEX), still gated on no stage-2 payload. child_process.spawn remains surfaced at INFO but no longer gates.
